17use std::sync::Arc;
18
19use crate::{
20    common::{BitMatrix, Result},
21    point, Exceptions, Point,
22};
23
24/**
25 * @author Guenther Grau
26 */
27#[derive(Clone)]
28pub struct BoundingBox {
29    image: Arc<BitMatrix>,
30    topLeft: Point,
31    bottomLeft: Point,
32    topRight: Point,
33    bottomRight: Point,
34    minX: u32,
35    maxX: u32,
36    minY: u32,
37    maxY: u32,
38}
39impl BoundingBox {
40    pub fn new(
41        image: Arc<BitMatrix>,
42        topLeft: Option<Point>,
43        bottomLeft: Option<Point>,
44        topRight: Option<Point>,
45        bottomRight: Option<Point>,
46    ) -> Result<BoundingBox> {
47        let leftUnspecified = topLeft.is_none() || bottomLeft.is_none();
48        let rightUnspecified = topRight.is_none() || bottomRight.is_none();
49        if leftUnspecified && rightUnspecified {
50            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
51        }
52
53        let newTopLeft;
54        let newBottomLeft;
55        let newTopRight;
56        let newBottomRight;
57
58        if leftUnspecified {
59            newTopRight = topRight.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
60            newBottomRight = bottomRight.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
61            newTopLeft = point(0.0, newTopRight.y);
62            newBottomLeft = point(0.0, newBottomRight.y);
63        } else if rightUnspecified {
64            newTopLeft = topLeft.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
65            newBottomLeft = bottomLeft.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
66            newTopRight = point(image.getWidth() as f32 - 1.0, newTopLeft.y);
67            newBottomRight = point(image.getWidth() as f32 - 1.0, newBottomLeft.y);
68        } else {
69            newTopLeft = topLeft.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
70            newTopRight = topRight.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
71            newBottomLeft = bottomLeft.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
72            newBottomRight = bottomRight.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
73        }
74
75        Ok(BoundingBox {
76            image,
77            minX: newTopLeft.x.min(newBottomLeft.x) as u32,
78            maxX: newTopRight.x.max(newBottomRight.x) as u32,
79            minY: newTopLeft.y.min(newTopRight.y) as u32,
80            maxY: newBottomLeft.y.max(newBottomRight.y) as u32,
81            topLeft: newTopLeft,
82            bottomLeft: newBottomLeft,
83            topRight: newTopRight,
84            bottomRight: newBottomRight,
85        })
86    }
87
88    pub fn from_other(boundingBox: &BoundingBox) -> BoundingBox {
89        BoundingBox {
90            image: boundingBox.image.clone(),
91            topLeft: boundingBox.topLeft,
92            bottomLeft: boundingBox.bottomLeft,
93            topRight: boundingBox.topRight,
94            bottomRight: boundingBox.bottomRight,
95            minX: boundingBox.minX,
96            maxX: boundingBox.maxX,
97            minY: boundingBox.minY,
98            maxY: boundingBox.maxY,
99        }
100    }
101
102    pub fn merge(
103        leftBox: Option<BoundingBox>,
104        rightBox: Option<BoundingBox>,
105    ) -> Result<BoundingBox> {
106        if leftBox.is_none() {
107            return Ok(rightBox.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?.clone());
108        }
109        if rightBox.is_none() {
110            return Ok(leftBox.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?.clone());
111        }
112        let leftBox = leftBox.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
113        let rightBox = rightBox.ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?;
114
115        BoundingBox::new(
116            leftBox.image,
117            Some(leftBox.topLeft),
118            Some(leftBox.bottomLeft),
119            Some(rightBox.topRight),
120            Some(rightBox.bottomRight),
121        )
122    }
123
124    pub fn addMissingRows(
125        &self,
126        missingStartRows: u32,
127        missingEndRows: u32,
128        isLeft: bool,
129    ) -> Result<BoundingBox> {
130        let mut newTopLeft = self.topLeft;
131        let mut newBottomLeft = self.bottomLeft;
132        let mut newTopRight = self.topRight;
133        let mut newBottomRight = self.bottomRight;
134
135        if missingStartRows > 0 {
136            let top = if isLeft { self.topLeft } else { self.topRight };
137            let mut newMinY = top.y - missingStartRows as f32;
138            if newMinY < 0.0 {
139                newMinY = 0.0;
140            }
141            let newTop = point(top.x, newMinY);
142            if isLeft {
143                newTopLeft = newTop;
144            } else {
145                newTopRight = newTop;
146            }
147        }
148
149        if missingEndRows > 0 {
150            let bottom = if isLeft {
151                self.bottomLeft
152            } else {
153                self.bottomRight
154            };
155            let mut newMaxY = bottom.y as u32 + missingEndRows;
156            if newMaxY >= self.image.getHeight() {
157                newMaxY = self.image.getHeight() - 1;
158            }
159            let newBottom = point(bottom.x, newMaxY as f32);
160            if isLeft {
161                newBottomLeft = newBottom;
162            } else {
163                newBottomRight = newBottom;
164            }
165        }
166
167        BoundingBox::new(
168            self.image.clone(),
169            Some(newTopLeft),
170            Some(newBottomLeft),
171            Some(newTopRight),
172            Some(newBottomRight),
173        )
174    }
175
176    pub fn getMinX(&self) -> u32 {
177        self.minX
178    }
179
180    pub fn getMaxX(&self) -> u32 {
181        self.maxX
182    }
183
184    pub fn getMinY(&self) -> u32 {
185        self.minY
186    }
187
188    pub fn getMaxY(&self) -> u32 {
189        self.maxY
190    }
191
192    pub fn getTopLeft(&self) -> &Point {
193        &self.topLeft
194    }
195
196    pub fn getTopRight(&self) -> &Point {
197        &self.topRight
198    }
199
200    pub fn getBottomLeft(&self) -> &Point {
201        &self.bottomLeft
202    }
203
204    pub fn getBottomRight(&self) -> &Point {
205        &self.bottomRight
206    }
207}
